name: booking
description: Hotel booking platform. Two independent projects: backend (NestJS) and frontend (Nuxt), plus the spec in context/.

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test && npm run lint
